declared difference (truth fix T1): the bash awk matched the slotomatic markers on the raw line, so a string
literal holding "BEGIN BAJA AUTO GENERATED CODE" opened a region and its lines stopped counting (Lit
reported 4 hand-written lines, not 8; a long one hid a real WARN). A marker counts only inside a comment
now, the only place slot-o-matic writes it.
